title: Microfiber Cleaning Cloths: Good Housekeeping Lab Picks
desc: Five Good Housekeeping Cleaning Lab picks tested for cleaning speed, absorbency, streaks, lint and wash durability. Different surface-use awards are not directly comparable.

source.name: Good Housekeeping Institute — Best Microfiber Cleaning Cloths (2026)
source.note: All listed products, source labels and selection context were checked against the linked source by AllRanks on 2026-10-21. The source presents distinct use-case awards, not a like-for-like composite score; the displayed order follows its numbered article sections.
